<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
class FiberCallableBase322A {
    public static function make() { return new Fiber('self::run'); }
    public static function run(int $x) { echo get_called_class(), ':', $x, '|'; return $x + 1; }
}
class FiberCallableChild322A extends FiberCallableBase322A {}
set_error_handler(static function ($level) { echo $level, '|'; return true; });
$f = FiberCallableChild322A::make();
$f->start('7');
echo $f->getReturn();
restore_error_handler();

<?php
class FiberCallableBase322B {
    public function maker() { return function () { return new Fiber('self::run'); }; }
    public static function run() { echo get_called_class(), '|'; return 9; }
}
class FiberCallableChild322B extends FiberCallableBase322B {}
set_error_handler(static function () { echo 'D|'; return true; });
$o = new FiberCallableBase322B;
$maker = $o->maker();
$maker = $maker->bindTo(null, FiberCallableChild322B::class);
$f = $maker();
unset($maker, $o);
$f->start();
echo $f->getReturn();
restore_error_handler();

<?php
set_error_handler(static function () { echo 'D|'; return true; });
class ScopedParent322 {
    protected function task(int $value) { echo 'P', $value, '|'; return $value + 10; }
}
class ScopedReceiver322 extends ScopedParent322 {
    public function make() { return new Fiber([$this, 'parent::task']); }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'R', Fiber::getCurrent() !== null, '|'; }
}
$receiver = new ScopedReceiver322;
$fiber = $receiver->make();
unset($receiver);
echo 'K|';
$fiber->start(3);
echo $fiber->getReturn();

<?php
class ScopedAliasOther322 {
    public static function b() { echo 'WRONG|'; return 99; }
}
class ScopedAlias322 {
    private static function a() { echo 'A|'; return 1; }
    private static function b() { echo 'B|'; return 2; }
    public static function make(&$class, &$method) { return new Fiber([&$class, &$method]); }
}
$class = 'self';
$method = 'a';
set_error_handler(static function () use (&$class, &$method) {
    echo 'D|'; $class = 'ScopedAliasOther322'; $method = 'b'; return true;
});
$fiber = ScopedAlias322::make($class, $method);
$class = 'missing';
$method = 'missing';
echo 'C|';
$fiber->start();
echo $fiber->getReturn(), ':', $class, ':', $method;
restore_error_handler();

<?php
set_error_handler(static function () { echo 'D|'; throw new RuntimeException('selection-stop'); });
class ScopedThrow322 {
    private static function task() { echo 'WRONG|'; }
    public static function make() { return new Fiber('self::task'); }
}
try { $fiber = ScopedThrow322::make(); echo 'WRONG|'; }
catch (RuntimeException $error) { echo 'E|', $error->getMessage(); }

<?php
set_error_handler(static function () {
    echo 'D|'; Fiber::suspend('W'); echo 'H|'; return true;
});
class ScopedSuspend322 {
    private static function task() { echo 'T|'; return 11; }
    public static function make() { return new Fiber('self::task'); }
}
$maker = new Fiber(static function () { return ScopedSuspend322::make(); });
echo $maker->start(), '|';
$maker->resume();
$fiber = $maker->getReturn();
$fiber->start();
echo $fiber->getReturn();
restore_error_handler();

<?php
$fiber = new Fiber('error_reporting');
set_error_handler(static function () { echo 'D|'; return true; });
class ScopedRepeat322 {
    private static function task() { echo 'WRONG|'; }
    public static function replace(Fiber $fiber) { $fiber->__construct('self::task'); }
}
try { ScopedRepeat322::replace($fiber); }
catch (FiberError $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), '|'; }
$fiber->start(19);
echo $fiber->getReturn(), ':', error_reporting(), ':', ini_get('error_reporting');
restore_error_handler();

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$child = null;
class CollectorCallable322 {
    public $cycle;
    private static function task(int $value) { echo 'T', $value, '|'; return $value + 1; }
    public function __destruct() {
        global $child;
        echo 'G', Fiber::getCurrent() !== null, '|';
        $child = new Fiber('self::task');
        echo 'C|';
    }
}
set_error_handler(static function () { echo 'D', Fiber::getCurrent() !== null, '|'; return true; });
$cycle = new CollectorCallable322;
$cycle->cycle = $cycle;
unset($cycle);
echo gc_collect_cycles(), '|';
$child->start('17');
echo $child->getReturn();
restore_error_handler();
